input:
Earlier scenes:
这个男孩子叫孟子，孟子是古代的人。孟子的妈妈觉得住在哪儿对童年很重要，所以他们常常搬了家。她望子成龙，所以孟子的妈妈安排他的生活。

This scene:
因为他们常常搬了家，中国人说，孟母三迁。孟子没有爸爸，所以，他的妈妈更重要。从这儿到那儿，妈妈教孟子很多技能。先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿，然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 因为他们常常搬了家：搬家，no了for routine/habit
- 妈妈教孟子很多技能：教了，了completed
- 先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿：她先让……，Subj.先……
- 然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西：质量又好

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 常常搬了家：常常搬家，A habitual action uses no 了 because it is not presented as one completed event. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿：她先让孟子跟朋友玩儿，The subject comes before the time/order adverbial 先. [rule: adverbial_word_order]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 又便宜又好质量的东西：又便宜又质量好的东西，质量好 is the correct adjective phrase; 好质量 cannot directly modify 东西 in this structure. [rule: none]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 妈妈教孟子很多技能：她教孟子很多技能，妈妈 was just mentioned in the preceding sentence and no other female character competes with the reference, so a pronoun is more natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

items.reason: 常常 describes a habitual action, so 搬家 should not take perfective 了.
The subject 她 must precede the sequencing adverb 先 in this clause.
好质量 is not an appropriate modifier here; 质量好/质量好的 correctly expresses that the quality is good.
妈妈 was just mentioned, so 她 is the appropriate close re-reference, but the corrected clause still needs 教了 to mark the completed teaching event.
